title: Request for review of power connection schematic for stm32f051r8t6
content: Dear team, hello, I've drawn a power supply circuit diagram for the STM32F051R8T6 but I'm a little hesitant. The diagram of my circuit is below. Have I done it correctly? Thank you for your answer.

scraped_replies.html: For lower ADC noise levels, place a ferrite of approx 1k ohms at clock frequency between 3.3V and VDDA.

BOOT0 should be tied or pulled to ground.

You need some way to program it. An SWD connection on a standard programming header like STLINK-V3MINIE or similar is recommended.

Otherwise, looks good.

Power nets and decoupling capacitors could be drawn a bit cleaner.

 

Follow the design guide:

https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an4080-getting-started-with-stm32f0x1x2x8-hardware-development-stmicroelectronics.pdf
